# netscalersdx_ssl_cert (Data Source)

Retrieve an SSL Certificate by its ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netscalersdx_ssl_cert" "tf_ssl_cert" {
  file_name = "tf_ssl_cert.pem"
  # file_location_path is the local DIRECTORY that contains the file named by
  # file_name, on the machine running `terraform apply`. The uploaded file is
  # "<file_location_path>/<file_name>" (here /path/to/your/certs/tf_ssl_cert.pem)
  # and is stored on the SDX appliance under file_name.
  file_location_path = "/path/to/your/certs"
}

data "netscalersdx_ssl_cert" "data_tf_ssl_cert" {
  id = netscalersdx_ssl_cert.tf_ssl_cert.id
}

output "ssl_cert_file_size" {
  value = data.netscalersdx_ssl_cert.data_tf_ssl_cert.file_size
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The ID of this data source. It is the same as the `file_name` value.

### Read-Only

- `file_last_modified` (String) Last Modified timestamp of the file on the SDX appliance.
- `file_last_modified_epoch` (String) Last Modified (Epoch) timestamp of the file on the SDX appliance, in epoch seconds.
- `file_location_path` (String) File Location. Not populated by the data source: the SDX appliance returns an empty value for this field on reads.
- `file_name` (String) File Name. Minimum length =  1 Maximum length =  256
- `file_size` (Number) File size in bytes as reported by the SDX appliance.
